source: Fantrax league history scrape (2024, 2025) by Eddie, normalized to data/teams.json ids by owner.
rule: History follows the owner. A former team name rolls into a current club only when the same owner ran it. Owners who have left the league keep their own id, listed in pastOwners.
counts: Regular season and winners-bracket playoff games only. Consolation games (including the 2025 Ultimate Loser Bowl) are left out of this file.
